Name: Jahath, Son of Reaiah
Summary: Son of Reaiah and father of Ahumai and Lahad.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:2: Son of Reaiah and father of Ahumai and Lahad.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jahath stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
